rejected.detail: Stock too high-priced for current $25k account. Gate 0 passes (all 4 perspectives echo direction=long). Gate 1 passes (can_open_new_position=true, phase=full). Gate 2 expected_return_per_share computation: p_bull = 7/(7+8) = 0.4667; p_catalyst = 7/(7+7) = 0.5000; combined_p_bull = 0.4833, combined_p_bear = 0.5167. Entry = midpoint of b_bull_a.entry_zone (1670+1675)/2 = $1672.50. Target = min(b_bull_a.target=1780, b_bull_b.target=1825) = $1780. Stop = max(b_bull_a.stop=1625, b_bull_b.stop=1628) = $1628. expected_return_per_share = 0.4833*(1780-1672.50) - 0.5167*(1672.50-1628) = 51.95 - 22.99 = +$28.96 (positive — EV gate would have passed). Gate 3 quantity: risk_dollars = $25000 * 1% * 1.0 = $250; risk_per_share = |1672.50 - 1628| = $44.50; quantity = floor(250/44.50) = 5 shares. Gate 4 — single-position cap: notional = 5 * $1672.50 = $8362.50, which exceeds 15% cap ($3750). Small-scaled exception path: M = floor($5000/$1672.50) = 2 shares; notional_M = $3345.00 (within 20% extended cap); risk_M = 2 * $44.50 = $89.00. Risk floor (40% of risk budget) = $100. Since risk_M ($89) < risk_floor ($100), the small-scaled exception fails. No viable quantity exists where notional <= 20% AND risk used >= 40% of budget. REJECT per Gate 4 reject path. Note: the technical bears (b_bear_a.bear_strength=8) make a strong case independently — daily rsi_7=85.42, dual bearish rsi_divergence on daily and hourly, bollinger pct_b=0.8945, z_score_50=1.76, dist_from_50sma_pct=54.9%, breakout printed on relative_volume=0.67 (below 20-day avg) — but the trade fails purely on Gate 4 capital math before that synthesis even matters.

summary: SNDK rejected on Gate 4 single_position_cap_exceeded. At $1672.50 entry the Gate-3 quantity (5 shares) blows past the 15% notional cap, and the small-scaled exception fails because 2 shares only uses $89 of risk budget ($100 floor required). Expected return was positive (+$28.96/share) but the $25k account cannot fit a viable position in a $1600+ stock under current capital rules.
